title: Fragment — On the Void That Precedes

pages.text: Before the stone, the Void. Before the Void, nothing, which is the same as the Void, which is why the name is redundant but useful. The Void That Precedes is not empty. Emptiness is the absence of a thing. The Void That Precedes is the absence of the concept of a thing, which is different. Thou canst not have a hole without a fabric to have the hole in. The Void That Precedes is prior to the fabric.

The grey stone is the Void's first attempt at the fabric. This is why the stone resonates — it is vibrating between what it is and what it almost was not. Every grey stone is a small miracle of persistence, and like all miracles of persistence, it carries within it the complete history of its own improbability.

The bell, rung correctly, speaks to that improbability. The bell says: thou art here. The stone says: I know. The body between them says nothing, because the body is only the medium through which the conversation passes.
